title: Radio: John Lennon on WNEW-FM | 1974
content:
John Lennon made an appearance on WNEW-FM in New York on 28 September 1974.

Lennon was accompanied in the studio by his partner May Pang. During the two-hour appearance Lennon spoke to presenter Dennis Elsas about his new album Walls And Bridges, recorded station idents and promo spots, and presented weather reports.
